narrative: During the week of August 10–16, 2026, President Donald Trump signed a single executive order, EO 14420, titled "Delivering Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations for Americans." This order addressed multiple key themes by enhancing vaccine policy and public health emergency response, while also emphasizing religious liberty and K-12 education policy. Additionally, it established a presidential commission tasked with guiding these integrated public health initiatives.

orders.title: Delivering Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations for Americans
